q: Under the 2019 revised checklist, what is the physical plant floor area of a RESIDENTIAL drug abuse treatment and rehabilitation center?
n: The 2019 checklist uses 420 m²; Annex D (2016) said at least 400 m² for 30 patients. Remember this: DATRC "1-8 to sleep, 1-10 to bathe": toilet/bath ratio 1:8 in the checklist, and 1 bathroom-toilet-lavatory per 10 patients in Annex D. Beds 1 m apart; bunk beds need 1 m headroom. DTL walls tiled 1.22 m, counters 400 mm, ceiling 2.40 m.

q: Under the 2019 revised checklist, what is the physical plant floor area of a NON-residential (outpatient) center?
n: 2019: 60 m². Annex D (2016) gave at least 25 m².

q: How far apart must beds be placed in a residential DATRC?
ref: DOH AO 2016-0042, Annex D (Rev. 00, 12/14/2016), item f.a

q: If double-decked beds are used, what clearance is required?
o: 1.50 m from the ceiling and 0.75 m between beds
At least 1 meter from the ceiling and 1 meter between upper and lower beds
ref: DOH AO 2016-0042, Annex D (Rev. 00, 12/14/2016), item f.b
n: One metre above and one metre between.

q: What living-quarters area per bed applies in the residential DATRC checklists?
o: At least 3.72 sq. m. per bed
At least 5.02 sq. m. per bed
At least 7.43 sq. m. per bed
At least 9.29 sq. m. per bed
ref: DOH DC 2019-0377 (July 3, 2019), Annex H-3a; DOH AO 2016-0042, Annex H-3a, item 1.5
n: Same 7.43 m²/bed used across DOH facilities.

q: What is the minimum area of the medical records room in the 2019 residential DATRC checklist?
n: New in 2019: medical records room at least 9.0 m², plus a perimeter fence.

q: What new site element did the 2019 residential DATRC checklist add?
In Annex D, how many patients does the minimum 400 sq. m. residential center serve?
ref: DOH AO 2016-0042, Annex D (Rev. 00, 12/14/2016), item C
n: At least 400 m² for 30 patients (dining and multipurpose areas sized at 42 m² for 30 persons).

q: What minimum floor-to-ceiling height applies to a drug testing laboratory?
n: At least 2.40 m for proper ventilation.

q: How high must the wall tiles of the DTL specimen collection area reach from the finished floor?
n: Unglazed floor tiles, glazed wall tiles at least 1.22 m high.

q: What minimum height of countertop wall or wainscot finish is required in a DTL?
n: Glazed tiles or smooth laminate at least 400 mm high.

q: What is the minimum blade diameter of the exhaust fan over the DTL working counter?
n: Ceiling- or wall-mounted exhaust fan, at least 10" blade.

q: In the DTL checklist, the client's area and the clinical working area must each be at least:
ref: DOH AO 2016-0042, Annex H-4, items 1.1 and 1.2
n: Client area min. 10 m² (waiting for at least 5 seats); clinical working area min. 10 m².
